caseNameFull: Lee Wing Wah v. Edward White, as Commissioner of Immigration for the Port of San Francisco

opinions.text: January 17,1921. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for. the Ninth Circuit denied. Mr. Jackson.H. Ralston and Mr. George W. Hott for petitioners. Mr. Assistant Attorney General Stewart and Mr. H. S. Ridgely for respondent.
